assertions: The ship is lost, not safe — it will not return safely to port
The ship has suffered wreck / fatal damage at sea and is ended, its principal significator being afflicted in the 4th house of the end of the matter / the grave

The merchant loses the ship and its cargo / goods, with serious loss to his money and substance — Mars in his fall near the cusp of the 2nd and Part of Fortune in the 6th disposed by retrograde afflicted Jupiter in the 2nd
The crew / those aboard are in mortal danger, with loss of life — Moon lately separated from a square of Saturn, lord of the 8th house of death
No good news of the ship is to be expected: Moon void of course after the Saturn square, then applying to opposition of Mercury, lord of the 12th and 4th, Mercury in detriment and entering combustion
method: Classical horary astrology (Lilly, Christian Astrology Book II, ship question — whole-sign / classical significators, Moon's applications, houses 1st/2nd/4th/8th/9th/12th)
reasoning: Every testimony is afflicted with no saving testimony: Moon separated from square Saturn L8/L9 then void of course (no favourable outcome, no news), then to trine Saturn and opposition Mercury L12/L4 in detriment and entering combustion (hidden loss and ending, messenger/ship blinded and burnt); Jupiter dispositor of Mercury subterranean conjunct Mars in a malefic term; Mars in fall near 2nd cusp (merchant's money harmed); Part of Fortune in cadent 6th, disposed by retrograde afflicted Jupiter in 2nd and squared by Jupiter to both PoF and Moon; principal significator in 4th and afflicted (end = grave/bottom). Confluence points to wreck/loss, not safety.
summary: The ship is lost and will not come home safe, with loss of cargo and grave danger to those aboard.
